get.summary: The HTTP server answers. Does not contact Proxmox.
What the server's Proxmox token can do with the stored configuration.
get.description:
Asks Proxmox (`GET /access/permissions`) for the token's privileges on
every ACL path the operations need, then lists per operation what is
required and what is missing.

502.description: Proxmox rejected the request or answered unusably

put.description:
The body is `server.toml`. Send `If-None-Match: *` for the first upload
and `If-Match: "<config_version>"` (or `*`) afterwards. The text is
validated like Python's `config.load_config` and stored atomically; the
previous file is kept as a backup. Uploading the stored text again
changes nothing.

412.description: The stored version is not the one in If-Match, or a configuration exists despite If-None-Match

428.description: Neither If-Match nor If-None-Match: * was sent

config_version.description: Configuration the ACL paths were derived from.

token_id.description: The server's Proxmox token, `USER@REALM!TOKENID` (never the secret).

changed.description: `false` when the text was already stored; nothing was written then.

config_version.description: SHA-256 of the stored text, also sent as the `ETag`.

SHA-256 of the stored `server.toml`, lowercase hex; `null` before the
first upload.

gold_candidates.description:
VMs tagged `homestack-gold`: `vmid`, `name`, `node`, `status`, `tags`
where Proxmox reports them.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes of the HomeStack API.

field.description:
The configuration field a `config_invalid` error is about, e.g.
`repo.owner`.

oneOf.description: The configured Gold VM; `null` when it does not exist (see `warnings`).

workspaces.description: Workspaces (`homestack-ws`) and alien VMs (`homestack-alien`), by VMID.

HomeUsage.description:
A workspace home. Without guest data only `size_bytes` (from the VM
config) is known.

physical_available_bytes.description: Always `null`; kept for the CLI's output shape.

ok.description: Whether the capacity could be read.

Liveness.description:
Body of `GET /health/live`. It only says the HTTP server answers; it does
not check Proxmox.

NetworkCandidate.description: One network profile a workspace could use (`GET /v1/networks`).

source.description: Where it was found, e.g. `HomeStack workspace VM 200`.

NodeState.description: A cluster node and whether Proxmox reports it online.

Operation.description: A HomeStack operation whose Proxmox privileges the server checks.

OperationCapability.description: Whether the token can perform one operation.

missing.description: The required privileges the token does not have.

required.description: Every privilege the operation needs, sorted by path and name.

OrphanVolume.description: A HomeStack volume (`vm-<vmid>-hs-(root|home)-<name>`) no VM uses.

Privilege.description: A Proxmox privilege on an ACL path.

PveVersion.description: Proxmox VE version, as returned by `GET /version`.

StatusEntry.description: One VM in the global status.

oneOf.description: Home usage; `null` for Gold, alien VMs, a missing home or an offline node.

status.description: Proxmox status (`running`, `stopped`, `unknown` on an offline node).

orphan_scan_complete.description:
`false` when a node or storage that holds HomeStack volumes could not
be scanned.

root_storage.description: Capacity of the configured node's default storage.

actual_hostname.description: From the guest agent, when the VM runs and the agent answers.

actual_ip.description: `address/prefix` of the first IPv4 address on `eth0`.

home_mount_ok.description: The home filesystem is ext4 on the VM's home disk.

home_serial.description: `serial=` of the home disk in the VM config.
